recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It narrowly completes the already-approved and already-applied FHIR-19569 wording without introducing broader Resource-page changes.
issue_request: FHIR-19569 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I change request for the Resource page. It asked to replace redundant wording about most resources deriving from DomainResource and Bundle collections with text explaining that Resource is the ancestor of DomainResource and that Bundle, Parameters, and Binary extend Resource directly; the resolution also explicitly corrected "recources" to "resources".
initial_application: Commit 146c14f37fbb1b43d6987f6f425b887dfc2a0fcb, submitted from PR 1934, applied the replacement sentence in source/resource/resource-introduction.xml and linked FHIR-19569. That historical application preserved the intended meaning but left the misspelling "recources", which was still present on the latest combined branch before this reconciliation.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini maps resource to the Resource type page and lists Resource as active resource infrastructure, confirming that source/resource/resource-introduction.xml feeds the current build. Zulip and Confluence searches for FHIR-19569 and the relevant Resource/DomainResource wording found no contrary community evidence.
reconciliation: Changed only "recources" to "resources" in source/resource/resource-introduction.xml line 42 and published the fix to the combined branch.
source_changes: source/resource/resource-introduction.xml: corrected "recources" to "resources" in the Resource Boundaries and Relationships paragraph.
